# Sync Race Studios

> Business services for local and independent businesses: website design, Google Business Profile setup and upkeep, Google Ads management, print marketing and creative, and small web apps that make a business more efficient. One partner, every piece connected. Clients own every account (domain, Google Business Profile, Google Ads, code) from the start.

After launch, clients choose one of three: self-manage at no ongoing cost, pay hourly for changes as they come up, or take an optional flat monthly care plan covering updates, backups, profile upkeep, small changes and monitoring. The monthly plan is cancellable at any time and nothing switches off if it ends.

Websites and apps are hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript, hosted on Vercel, with Supabase for data and Cloudflare for DNS. No page builders, no platform lock-in, and no tracking without consent.

The logo is a dragon curve: a strip of paper folded in half ten times and opened so every crease is 90°, giving one line of 1,024 steps that never crosses itself. It stands for taking every part of a business and unwinding it into one cohesive line.

## Projects

- Wanderlust Santa Rosa (wanderlustsantarosa.com): Website for a free weekly food truck festival in Old Courthouse Square, Santa Rosa, with a vendor application and market admin. HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Supabase, Vercel. Live.
- Stay Santa Rosa (staysantarosa.com): Travel guide to Santa Rosa and Sonoma wine country created by Hotel E and Art House Santa Rosa, with a searchable 79-place directory and direct hotel booking. Live.
- Surfline 8th Ave. So (surflinejaxbeach.com): Marketing website with an availability calendar for a Jacksonville, Florida vacation rental. Live.
- Visual HTML editor (htmlv.srcs.online): Lets clients change text and images on their own site without touching code.
